design_principles: stable UUIDs
platform-neutral records
lossless JSON archive
CSV as human-friendly tabular view
uncertainty-aware acquisition dates
book is distinct from edition
reading journey is distinct from book
atomic sessions support downstream reports and yearly recaps
notes and ideas remain linkable
capture context once and inherit until it changes
metadata is progressively enrichable
first Start creates Day 1; later Starts create sessions
historical facts remain distinct from measured app events
new acquisitions always enter the uncategorized Shelf
Shelf is a library state, not the first stage of a required pipeline
from Shelf, a book may move directly to Currently Reading or optionally to Up Next
Up Next is optional and never a prerequisite for reading
status is decided when a Shelf book is pulled out, not during acquisition
reader feedback capture is text-first; classification is optional
photo library upload is distinct from camera capture
book metadata may be enriched from a public bibliographic lookup and confirmed by the reader
existing reading reports can be imported with preview before commit
full archive restore is distinct from records import
acquisition places may retain a map/search reference without requiring a typed full address

acquisition_event.future_place_link: structured place reference / map provider ID
